name: Old Gristle, the Fold-Breaker
place: wilds: Gristle's Hollow (set piece sp_gristles_hollow, zone 'test'), 300-600 m from Greyfletch Camp; respawn 2-4 min per copy (a quest boss everyone on the starting chain needs)
_doc: Stream E (play-test 2, Q27). The starting chain's mini boss: the grey-muzzled moor hound that has led the packs into the Torborhold folds for nine winters, now the size of a pony. Play-test 3 R2: level 2 (was 4: "boss level 4 / 272 hp, me level 2 / 130 hp"), hpMult 3.5 -> ~144 hp at level 2, about a level-2 character's own health. Fair and readable for a level-2 solo: a frontal bite cone (bleed), a long pounce on whoever is FARTHEST (a line from him — sidestep), a howl that calls a moor hound at 60% and another at 30%, and a shake-off ring when you stand close too long. Every wind is at least the R4 floor (2.05 s; 2.45 s for the pounce, a long line).
party: Starting-chain mini boss. Solo: level 2 intended (bots win 30/30 at level 1 and 2 — tests/C/playtest3), easier if you sidestep the pounce and kill the hounds he calls. 2-3: easy. M5 scaling: health by players tagged; the howl calls +1 hound per extra player (1 solo).

pull: A grey shape the size of a pony unfolds from the bones. Old Gristle has been waiting.
The bones shift. Something under them is breathing.
say.death: Old Gristle lies down for the last time. The folds of Torborhold will sleep tonight.
say.reset: Old Gristle slinks back into the hollow and starts gnawing again.

pounce.name: Long Pounce
pounce.say: Old Gristle crouches low, eyes on {target}!

shake.name: Shake Off
shake.say: Old Gristle bristles and shakes himself.

phases.name: Calling the Pack
phases.say: Old Gristle throws back his head and howls!

phases.name: The Pack Answers
phases.say: Old Gristle howls again — the pack answers!
